title: Leveraging Medulloblastoma Clonal Dynamics to Overcome Treatment Resistance
model: Group 3 medulloblastoma cells, TKOv3 genome-wide knockout, BMI1 inhibitor PTC596
contrast: PTC596 vs DMSO, paired by replicate (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: Sensitizers intersected with phosphoproteomics point to mTOR, AKT, PLK1 and PI3K pathways
named_hits: Core mTOR, AKT, PI3K and PLK1 genes not depleted; EED #1 (FDR 0.08, enriched)
verdict: BARCS does not find the core mTOR, AKT, PI3K or PLK1 genes depleted under PTC596; only two genes pass FDR 0.10, led by EED (PRC2), whose loss is enriched. The paper chose pathways by intersecting its sensitizer list with phosphoproteomics, and that list is not deposited, so the comparison is indirect.
